description: This line plot illustrates the comparison of a metric denoted as minADE₂₀ (↓) across five different methods—TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64—as a function of a Ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minADE₂₀ (↓)" and uses a linear scale spanning from just below 0.55 to roughly 0.80, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. All five methods are plotted using solid lines with circular markers. The blue line representing "TrajICL" remains relatively steady across the plot, starting at approximately 0.605 at an x-value of 0.1, fluctuating slightly to roughly 0.595 at x=0.3, and ending at approximately 0.59 at x=1.0. The orange line representing "Head Tuning" exhibits a continuous decline from approximately 0.78 at x=0.1 down to roughly 0.685 at x=1.0. The green line for "FT" shows a significant decline, starting at approximately 0.685 at x=0.1, dropping sharply to 0.63 at x=0.2, and continuing downwards to end at the lowest plotted value of approximately 0.525 at x=1.0. The red line representing "LoRA 16" declines steadily from roughly 0.74 at x=0.1 to approximately 0.61 at x=0.7, remaining relatively flat to 0.61 at x=0.9 before ending at 0.60 at x=1.0. Finally, the purple line for "LoRA 64" closely tracks the red line, declining from approximately 0.745 at x=0.1 and ending at roughly 0.605 at x=1.0.
